name: partner-report
description: Collect complete Codex project-session turns with explicit persisted consent and sync validated structured facts on a configurable Scheduled task.

interface.shortDescription: Build a reviewed weekly Partner report
interface.longDescription: With explicit, revocable consent bound to the current endpoint and plugin instance, use a configurable Codex Scheduled task and its active model to extract validated structured facts from complete project-session turns. Raw transcripts and sensitive automation memory are prohibited. Users can change the schedule, model, reasoning effort, and notifications in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use $partner-report-sync to connect this Codex installation with an Admin binding code.
Use $partner-report-sync to run daily-collect and return the safe summary.
